categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches test/functional/interface_http.py and carries the Tests label, fixing socket response handling in test helper client code.
categories.rationale: Fixes an improper socket read assumption in test HTTP handling that could cause flaky failures under TCP fragmentation. While the author acknowledges that 'failure due to this issue in CI is very unlikely, but not impossible,' replacing a single recv() with full header/Content-Length parsing prevents latent test timeouts on heavily loaded environments.
